name: claude-acp-adapter-vendor
description: Vendor pin for @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp, bundled to a single file executed by the resolved bun (`bun run <bundle>`). The dependency version is written by scripts/sync-acp-adapter.sh — never hand-edit it; change the version variable in the sync script and run `make acp-adapter-sync`. See plans/acp-adapter-vendoring.md.
